meta.name: vercel-cli
meta.description: Deploy apps to Vercel. Use when asked to deploy, ship, or publish a web application, or manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把网页应用发布到 Vercel，管理域名和环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把网站部署到 Vercel 并管理其设置
copy.tagline_en: Deploy web apps to Vercel and manage domains and env vars
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly deploy websites to Vercel and manage their settings.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能使用 Vercel 命令行工具部署网站、管理项目、域名和环境变量。部署前会先本地构建检查，部署后确认线上地址可访问才告诉你。
howto.when: 当用户要求部署或发布网页应用，或管理 Vercel 项目、域名等资源时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个网站部署到 Vercel 生产环境。
say.note: Claude 会先跑构建，再部署并确认线上地址。

say.text: 看看我 Vercel 上有哪些项目。
给当前项目添加域名 example.com。
say.note: Claude 会执行域名添加并反馈结果。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can deploy websites to Vercel and manage projects, domains, and environment variables using the Vercel CLI. It runs a local build before deploying and verifies the live URL before reporting back.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to deploy or publish a web app, or manage Vercel projects, domains, or similar resources.

say_en.text: Deploy this website to Vercel production.
say_en.note: Claude runs the build, deploys, and verifies the URL.

say_en.text: Add domain example.com to the current project.
say_en.note: Claude adds the domain and confirms.
